        @dataclass

            title: str
            release_date: dt.date


        class AlbumSchema(Schema):
            title = fields.Str()
            release_date = fields.Date()


        album = Album("Beggars Banquet", dt.date(1968, 12, 6))
        schema = AlbumSchema()

        can be represented with dot delimiters.

        delimiters.
